findings.assessment: The parent supplied the directly observed human message and its preceding four-step scope. Supplement records that existing decision rather than manufacturing a tool-call ID or treating a file as a new authorization. Bounded offline preparation, independent review and one conditional current8B case with one result review and retry0 match the main plan.

Exact message UTF8 digest identifier plus exact answer and a fixed decision-file SHA sealed in the preparation manifest provides a bounded alternate representation. Identifier is explicitly not a platform message ID and does not alone authenticate a human or identify a unique chat. Fixed prepared root, source/manifest/review/candidate binding and existing one-use gate supply the contextual restriction.

Plan preserves closed allocation schema, current candidate/model, independently approved manifest/review, one case and one result review, retry0, issued<=now<expires with at most120 seconds, preconsumption and post-consumption drift check. Supplement does not itself issue a release.

implementation_review_checks: The new direct-message branch must require exact decision_id and answer, verify fixed decision-file bytes/hash before use, and fail closed for missing, altered, similar or blank records. Hash the actual specified UTF8 bytes without implicit trimming/normalization.

Require the decision JSON as a sealed preparation member, with its user message, preceding proposal and accepted scope faithfully represented. The file is an engineering binding of the observed message, never an independent authorization source.

Keep existing call_ branch and its explicitly excluded spent zero-inference ID unchanged. Test the old spent grant rejection and candidate/manifest/review/expiry/allocation mismatch rejection; do not interpret unchanged call_ prefix acceptance as proof any arbitrary old call is authentic.
Run entry regressions and independent exact-manifest preparation review before any conditional runtime release. Preserve exclusive consumed receipt and fail-closed replay protection.
